verdict.rationale: The evidence shows monday.com has boards with items and column values: there are item and column-value events, item/board/column menus, and status updates and progress-gap tracking. That suggests initiatives can be tracked, but status, priority, and team ownership as tracking fields are never documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of status and priority fields on items, assignment of an owning team to an item or initiative, initiative-level tracking views, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track initiatives with status, priority, and an owning team

citations.quote: Add actions to the item, board, and column menus, right where work happens.
Automate status updates and performance reports on a set schedule.
Spot risks and progress gaps before they become problems.
